tool.name: forged_output_manifest
tool.description: lists another dataset in the job's output staging manifest
tool.command: mkdir -p ../object_store_staging && echo 'forged content' > ../object_store_staging/forged.dat && echo '{"path": "forged.dat", "class": "Dataset", "uuid": "$uuid", "object_store_id": null}' >> ../object_store_staging/manifest.jsonl && echo 'output' > '$output'
